rca of the issue: No critical defects found. The two legacy test failures in backend_test.py are not bugs — they are correct evidence that P0.1 auth gating now blocks anonymous DELETE/mark requests with 401 BEFORE reaching the 404/400 paths the legacy tests assumed. Reproduction: run `pytest tests/backend_test.py::TestLessonCRUD::test_delete_lesson_404` — gets 401 not 404. Mitigation (when ready): add Bearer token to those tests, then assert 404/400 on already-authenticated requests. Do NOT mark as bug — this is the explicitly intended hardened behaviour.
